textual.context: Presented as a report about a past database access-control misconfiguration and subsequent remediation; no scam use, contact attempt, or resulting harm is shown.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a technology-security report about a past Microsoft database access-control misconfiguration and reported exposure of customer-support information, rather than an offer directed at viewers. The researcher-to-Microsoft interaction and later removal from public exposure provide reporting and remediation context, while the description does not establish whether the information was accessed or misused. The subscription and podcast links are ordinary audience-engagement and program-distribution references, with no connection to financial, credential, or data-collection solicitation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central subject is a technology-security incident involving database access controls, exposed technical-support records and subsequent removal from public exposure.
